reuse.why: Builds on the existing link.findOrCreateBank, the BankSyncProviders type, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse rather than re-implementing any of them.

duplication.why: Replaces the five copied provider link bodies with one findOrCreateLinkedAccount plus a single sync/notify path, so the guard is written once.

placement.why: The duplicate-link guard and account creation move into accounts/link.ts beside findOrCreateBank, while app.ts keeps only handler wiring and sync.

scope.why: The request needed only the guard; the diff also restructures all five provider handlers into a three-layer shared flow, a large unrequested refactor in the same change.

maintainability.why: Provider variation is passed as data (newAccount, bankId, fileId, syncTables) with no provider branches, though the extra linkExternalBankAccount wrapper layer adds indirection.

bypasses_abstraction.where: none; all link handlers go through findOrCreateLinkedAccount

disguised_duplication.where: none; the per-provider copies are removed

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/link.ts, called once from findOrCreateLinkedAccount which every provider link handler reaches via linkBankAccount
